M2 Task 15 test sub-issue.
Parent: #75
Depends on: #75
Acceptance: every required tool name is registered with strict schemas; read/status tools require no mutation lock; task logs/evidence cannot cross task boundaries or expose secrets.
Target: P0 / MCP / High / M2 / M.

issues.title: M2 live acceptance and v0.1.0 release gate
issues.body:
M2 Task 16 release-gate issue.
Parent: #37
Depends on: #73, #74, #76
Acceptance: one real disposable private-repo task modifies code, verifies, pushes, confirms remote SHA, releases lock before PR, observes CI lock-free, reaches COMPLETED, and records timestamps proving `remote_confirm <= lock_release < pr_create <= ci_observe`.
Target: P0 / Ops / Critical / M2 / L.

issues.title: M3 Epic — Reliability & Recovery
issues.body:
Parent epic for M3 — Reliability & Recovery.
Scope: boot/process lock identity, stale-lock assessment, workspace/task recovery, bounded retry, resumable steps, janitor retention, crash/concurrency tests, task controls, v0.2.0 acceptance.
Children: #79–#97.
Target: P0 / Task / Critical / M3 / XL.

issues.title: Persist process and boot identity for Repo Lock ownership
issues.body: M3 Task 1. Parent: #78. Depends on: #43–#45. Store PID + `/proc/.../boot_id` with lock ownership; fail closed if boot ID unavailable during mutation acquisition. Target: P0 / Task / High / M3 / S.

issues.title: Assess stale Repo Locks without mutating state
issues.body: M3 Task 2. Parent: #78. Depends on: #79. Classify ACTIVE, ACTIVE_BUT_HEARTBEAT_LATE, STALE, CONFLICT, STALE_AFTER_REBOOT; assessment itself never deletes lock state. Target: P0 / Task / Critical / M3 / M.

issues.title: Assess interrupted task workspace Git state
issues.body: M3 Task 3. Parent: #78. Depends on: #46, #55. Read-only assessment covers existence, branch, HEAD, dirty/unpushed state, index lock, expected task branch match; never auto-reset/clean/delete. Target: P0 / Workspace / High / M3 / M.

issues.title: Recover interrupted tasks before normal scheduling
issues.body: M3 Task 4. Parent: #78. Depends on: #80, #81. Boot order: open DB/logging → recovery coordinator → scheduler → mutating MCP. Resume only from consistent durable state; otherwise NEEDS_RECOVERY and repo may be blocked. Target: P0 / Task / Critical / M3 / L.

issues.title: Persist recovery audit events and recovering health state
issues.body: M3 Task 4 sub-issue. Parent: #82. Depends on: #82. Emit TASK_RECOVERY_STARTED/TASK_RESUMED/TASK_NEEDS_RECOVERY/STALE_LOCK_RECLAIMED/REPO_RECOVERY_BLOCKED and expose `recovering` health until coordinator finishes. Target: P1 / Ops / High / M3 / S.

issues.title: Classify task failures for deterministic recovery policy
issues.body: M3 Task 5. Parent: #78. Depends on: #68. Implement TRANSIENT / CODE_FAILURE / ENVIRONMENT_FAILURE / POLICY_BLOCK / EXTERNAL_FAILURE / UNKNOWN classification for GitHub/network/compiler/test/tool/policy/CI failures. Target: P0 / Task / High / M3 / M.

issues.title: Implement bounded automatic retry policy for transient failures
issues.body: M3 Task 5 sub-issue. Parent: #84. Depends on: #84. Default transient schedule: 1s, 3s, 10s, then stop; CODE_FAILURE never blindly reruns identical work. Scheduler owns delays outside DB transactions. Target: P0 / Task / High / M3 / S.

issues.title: Implement resumable Step execution from durable outputs
issues.body: M3 Task 6. Parent: #78. Depends on: #82, #85. Reuse proven worktrees/PRs/remote SHA/verification PASS for unchanged HEAD; resume is based on durable artifacts, not step number alone. Target: P0 / Task / Critical / M3 / L.

issues.title: Persist resume tokens from branch, SHA, PR, and verification evidence
issues.body: M3 Task 6 sub-issue. Parent: #86. Depends on: #86. Validate durable branch/HEAD/remote SHA/PR/evidence before skipping completed work during recovery. Target: P1 / Task / High / M3 / M.

issues.title: Fail unsafe or ambiguous resumes into NEEDS_RECOVERY
issues.body: M3 Task 6 safety sub-issue. Parent: #86. Depends on: #87. Unexpected HEAD, unknown non-idempotent command outcome, or stale approval hash must become NEEDS_RECOVERY instead of guessing. Target: P0 / Security / Critical / M3 / S.

issues.title: Implement Workspace Janitor with retention safeguards
issues.body: M3 Task 7. Parent: #78. Depends on: #81, #82. Retention: COMPLETED clean worktrees 24h; FAILED/CANCELLED clean worktrees 7d; NEEDS_APPROVAL, NEEDS_RECOVERY, dirty, or unpushed worktrees are protected from auto-delete. Target: P0 / Workspace / High / M3 / M.

issues.title: Apply disk-pressure cleanup with immediate safety revalidation
issues.body: M3 Task 7 sub-issue. Parent: #89. Depends on: #89. At <80% no early cleanup; 80–89% prioritize oldest eligible completed worktrees; >=90% clear eligible completed worktrees/safe caches aggressively. Re-run git status, unpushed-commit and task-state checks immediately before removal. Target: P1 / Workspace / High / M3 / M.

issues.title: Prove different repositories mutate concurrently
issues.body: M3 Task 8 concurrency test. Parent: #78. Depends on: #43, #68. Use barriers in two fake mutation tasks and prove both may enter RUNNING simultaneously when immutable GitHub repo IDs differ. Target: P0 / Task / High / M3 / S.

issues.title: Prove same-repository mutations serialize
issues.body: M3 Task 8 concurrency test. Parent: #78. Depends on: #43, #62, #68. Start two tasks for one repo and prove the second remains WAITING_REPO_LOCK until the first task's remote-confirmed push causes lock release. Target: P0 / Task / Critical / M3 / S.

issues.title: Recover safely after process death while Repo Lock is held
issues.body: M3 Task 8 crash integration test. Parent: #78. Depends on: #79, #80, #82. Persist active task+lease, simulate worker death/new boot identity, run recovery, and prove stale-lock reconciliation never creates conflicting same-repo mutation. Target: P0 / Task / Critical / M3 / M.

issues.title: Recover after confirmed push without reacquiring lock for PR or CI
issues.body: M3 Task 8 restart integration test. Parent: #78. Depends on: #62, #63, #65, #82. Simulate restart after remote SHA confirmation but before PR creation; recovery must create/reuse PR and observe CI without reacquiring the repository mutation lock. Target: P0 / Task / Critical / M3 / M.

issues.title: Expose safe task cancellation over MCP
issues.body: M3 Task 9. Parent: #78. Depends on: #86. Implement `task_cancel` SAFE/CLEANUP modes. SAFE stops task-owned active process and preserves worktree/logs/dirty/unpushed state; CLEANUP refuses dirty, unpushed, NEEDS_RECOVERY, or otherwise unsafe removal. Target: P0 / MCP / High / M3 / M.

issues.title: Expose task resume, retry, and approval controls
issues.body: M3 Task 9. Parent: #78. Depends on: #85, #86, #95. Implement `task_resume`, `task_retry`, `task_approve` with strict schemas. Resume delegates to durable Step recovery; retry follows RetryPolicy; approval succeeds only when taskId, approvalId, and recomputed operationHash all match. Target: P0 / MCP / Critical / M3 / M.

issues.title: M3 acceptance and v0.2.0 release gate
issues.body: M3 Task 10 release gate. Parent: #78. Depends on: #89–#96. Run lint/typecheck/test/build/test:e2e/test:concurrency; perform one target-WSL restart acceptance proving safe resume or NEEDS_RECOVERY without conflicting same-repo mutation; record evidence before tagging v0.2.0. Target: P0 / Ops / Critical / M3 / L.

issues.title: M4 Epic — Windows Integration & Developer UX
issues.body:
Parent epic for M4 — Windows Integration & Developer UX.
Scope: typed Windows path/open/reveal/clipboard, Windows escape security, typed WSL system operations, GitHub conveniences, explicit direct-main grants, target Windows/WSL acceptance.
No generic `windows_exec` API; raw Windows executables remain approval-gated.
Children: #99–#112.
Target: P1 / Windows / High / M4 / XL.

issues.title: Implement Windows path conversion service
issues.body: M4 Task 1. Parent: #98. Depends on: #47. `windows_path` delegates to `wslpath` with direct argv, rejects NUL/unbounded paths, and never hard-codes distro or username. Typed operation is ALLOW. Target: P1 / Windows / Medium / M4 / S.

issues.title: Implement typed Windows open and reveal operations
issues.body: M4 Task 2. Parent: #98. Depends on: #99. Expose fixed `windows_open`/`windows_reveal` operations for validated paths and http/https URLs only; user input cannot select executable, script, or arbitrary switches. Target: P1 / Windows / High / M4 / M.

issues.title: Implement text-only secret-redacted Windows clipboard operations
issues.body: M4 Task 3. Parent: #98. Depends on: #100, #19. Expose text-only read/write with 1 MiB maximum, secret-redacted MCP output, audit metadata containing counts/results but not clipboard body; any PowerShell adapter uses fixed code and data via stdin/safe channel. Target: P1 / Windows / High / M4 / M.

issues.title: Add Windows escape security regression suite
issues.body: M4 Task 4. Parent: #98. Depends on: #99–#101. Test quotes, semicolons, newlines, ampersands, pipes, PowerShell subexpressions, `%COMSPEC%`, `$(...)`, UNC paths and disallowed URI schemes; strict schemas reject command/executable/args/script fields. Target: P0 / Security / Critical / M4 / M.

issues.title: Keep raw Windows executables approval-gated
issues.body: M4 security invariant from Tasks 3–4. Parent: #98. Depends on: #23, #102. Regression: `powershell.exe`, `pwsh.exe`, `cmd.exe`, and arbitrary Windows executables such as `notepad.exe` remain NEEDS_APPROVAL while typed path/open/reveal/clipboard tools remain constrained ALLOW operations. Target: P0 / Security / Critical / M4 / S.

issues.title: Implement typed WSL package operations
issues.body: M4 Task 5. Parent: #98. Depends on: #49, #103. `PackageService.installApt` validates Debian package names and uses direct argv through Policy; apt install may ALLOW while purge/removal remains NEEDS_APPROVAL. Target: P1 / Ops / High / M4 / M.

issues.title: Implement task-owned process management
issues.body: M4 Task 5 sub-issue. Parent: #98. Depends on: #49, #104. Expose typed process status/start/stop only for task-owned processes; use explicit service APIs rather than broad privileged shell shortcuts. Target: P1 / Ops / Medium / M4 / S.

issues.title: Implement typed systemd service operations
issues.body: M4 Task 5 sub-issue. Parent: #98. Depends on: #49, #104. Typed status/start/stop/restart for known services; systemctl enable/disable remains NEEDS_APPROVAL and unit-file editing is not hidden by this service. Target: P1 / Ops / High / M4 / M.

issues.title: Extend GitHub issue and PR convenience operations
issues.body: M4 Task 6. Parent: #98. Depends on: #63, #75. Add issue read/search and PR get/update/comment with adapter-scoped GitHub credentials, structured results, idempotency where possible, and audit events. Target: P1 / GitHub / Medium / M4 / M.

issues.title: Add lock-free GitHub Actions and check-log retrieval
issues.body: M4 Task 6 sub-issue. Parent: #98. Depends on: #65, #107. Actions/check log retrieval is read-only, uses scoped GitHub credentials, and has no repository mutation lock dependency. Target: P1 / GitHub / Medium / M4 / S.

issues.title: Implement explicit task-scoped direct-main grants
issues.body: M4 Task 7. Parent: #98. Depends on: #38, #57, #61. Persist an explicit task capability derived from the user's DIRECT_MAIN request; never infer it from agent preference. Default PULL_REQUEST tasks still require approval for normal protected-main push. Target: P1 / Git / Critical / M4 / M.

issues.title: Verify direct-main policy and remote-confirm lock-release invariant
issues.body: M4 Task 7 policy test. Parent: #98. Depends on: #109. PULL_REQUEST task → normal push main NEEDS_APPROVAL; DIRECT_MAIN with explicit grant → normal push main ALLOW; either mode force push or protected-branch delete DENY. Direct-main still follows verify → commit → push → remote confirm → lock release. Target: P0 / Security / Critical / M4 / S.

issues.title: Run M4 target Windows and WSL acceptance
issues.body: M4 Task 8 acceptance. Parent: #98. Depends on: #102–#110. Run lint/typecheck/test/build/test:security, then on target machine verify live worktree path conversion, approved open/reveal, non-secret clipboard round trip, and raw PowerShell still pauses for approval. Target: P0 / Windows / High / M4 / M.

issues.title: M4 review gate and Windows integration acceptance record
issues.body: M4 review gate. Parent: #98. Depends on: #111. Record `docs/operations/m4-windows-acceptance.md`, explicitly review no-windows_exec/raw-shell approval invariants and complete code review before M5 work is treated as accepted. Target: P1 / Ops / High / M4 / S.

issues.title: M5 Epic — Hardening & Production Readiness
issues.body:
Parent epic for M5 — Hardening & Production Readiness.
Scope: explicit threat model, security invariant suite, parser/path/symlink/secret/MCP hardening, bounded logging, SQLite integrity/backup, diagnostics, upgrade/rollback, operator runbooks, full v1.0 acceptance.
Children: #114–#130.
Target: P0 / Security / Critical / M5 / XL.

issues.title: Write explicit threat model
issues.body: M5 Task 1. Parent: #113. Depends on: #112. Document trust boundaries across ChatGPT/connector, OpenAI tunnel, local tunnel-client, loopback MCP, Task/Policy Engines, process boundary, WSL/Windows, GitHub and secret store, including accidental/malicious command, path escape, repo-script, secret, crash and corruption cases. Target: P0 / Security / High / M5 / M.

issues.title: Define testable security invariant IDs
issues.body: M5 Task 1 sub-issue. Parent: #114. Depends on: #114. Convert design invariants into SEC-* identifiers such as SEC-MCP-001 loopback-only, SEC-TUN-001 no runtime admin key, SEC-POL-001 protected force push denied, SEC-WIN-001 raw PowerShell approval, SEC-LOCK-001 lock-free CI. Target: P0 / Security / High / M5 / S.

issues.title: Harden shell parser against command-composition bypass
issues.body: M5 Task 2. Parent: #113. Depends on: #24, #115. Test nested/wrapped dangerous commands via `&&`, `;`, `||`, pipelines, subshells, `sh -c`, `bash -c`, `env`, and `sudo`; recursively analyze known wrappers and default unknown command-string wrappers to NEEDS_APPROVAL. Target: P0 / Security / Critical / M5 / M.

issues.title: Harden task filesystem against path traversal
issues.body: M5 Task 3. Parent: #113. Depends on: #53, #115. Cover POSIX `..`, repeated separators, absolute paths, `/proc`, `/etc`, `/mnt/c`, and new-file targets whose nearest existing parent leaves the canonical worktree. Target: P0 / Security / Critical / M5 / M.

issues.title: Harden task filesystem against symlink escape
issues.body: M5 Task 3 sub-issue. Parent: #113. Depends on: #117. Test symlinks inside worktrees targeting `/etc`, agent secret/config directories, `/mnt/c/Users`, and other task worktrees; task-scoped APIs must deny these escapes. Target: P0 / Security / Critical / M5 / M.

issues.title: Harden raw command environment against credential injection
issues.body: M5 Task 4. Parent: #113. Depends on: #50, #115. Seed fake GITHUB_TOKEN, CONTROL_PLANE_API_KEY, GRAM_MCP_INTERNAL_SECRET and OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY and prove raw CommandRunner children exclude them unless a specialized adapter leases a credential; OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY must never exist in the long-running app. Target: P0 / Security / Critical / M5 / M.

issues.title: Prove secrets cannot escape through logs, SQLite, clipboard, GitHub, or MCP
issues.body: M5 Task 4 sub-issue. Parent: #113. Depends on: #19, #50, #101, #107, #119. Fake command/clipboard/adapter outputs containing registered secrets must be redacted or omitted before log files, SQLite metadata, audit events and MCP results. Target: P0 / Security / Critical / M5 / M.

issues.title: Harden MCP authentication and tunnel transport configuration
issues.body: M5 Task 5. Parent: #113. Depends on: #22, #28–#31, #115. Reject non-loopback hosts and missing/wrong secrets without logging credentials; service/config/bootstrap must contain no OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY; official tunnel-client doctor procedure uses restricted Tunnels Read + Use runtime credentials. Target: P0 / MCP / Critical / M5 / M.

issues.title: Add bounded structured logging and rotation
issues.body: M5 Task 6. Parent: #113. Depends on: #27, #120. Redact before write; production defaults: agent log max 25 MiB, retain 10 files; command output max 100 MiB with redacted diagnostic samples and `truncated=true` when bounded. Target: P1 / Ops / High / M5 / M.

issues.title: Add SQLite integrity checking
issues.body: M5 Task 7. Parent: #113. Depends on: #17. Healthy database reports ok; corrupted copied fixture reports unhealthy and must prevent normal task scheduling until recovered. Target: P0 / Core / High / M5 / M.

issues.title: Add online-safe state backup and restore
issues.body: M5 Task 7 sub-issue. Parent: #113. Depends on: #123. Use SQLite-supported consistent online backup, not an unsafe live `.db` copy; restore stops services, snapshots current state, restores to a new file, runs migrations/integrity, atomically swaps and restarts. Target: P0 / Ops / Critical / M5 / L.

issues.title: Add secret-safe self-diagnostics
issues.body: M5 Task 8. Parent: #113. Depends on: #120–#124. Add read-only `agent_diagnostics` covering SQLite integrity, disk/worktree usage, stale locks, loopback MCP, secret configured status, Git/GitHub auth status without tokens, tunnel/systemd status and NEEDS_RECOVERY; never acquire mutation locks or return secret values. Target: P1 / Ops / High / M5 / M.

issues.title: Implement versioned upgrade workflow
issues.body: M5 Task 9. Parent: #113. Depends on: #124, #125. Upgrade sequence: verify clean source checkout → backup DB → fetch target tag → frozen install → build/test smoke → stop services → migrations → switch release → start agent → diagnostics → start/confirm tunnel. Preserve failure evidence; no destructive cleanup. Target: P1 / Ops / High / M5 / L.

issues.title: Implement rollback workflow with compatible state backup
issues.body: M5 Task 9 sub-issue. Parent: #113. Depends on: #126. Rollback restores the prior source tag and, when migration compatibility requires it, a compatible pre-upgrade state backup; scripts use `set -euo pipefail`, traps and testable dry-run/injected command boundaries. Target: P1 / Ops / Critical / M5 / M.

issues.title: Finish idempotent one-command WSL bootstrap and installation docs
issues.body: M5 Task 10. Parent: #113. Depends on: #30, #121, #125. Running bootstrap twice must not rotate existing secrets, duplicate services, destroy state, or unexpectedly reclone repos. Installation docs cover WSL/systemd, Node24/pnpm, build, permissions, GitHub auth, restricted OpenAI tunnel key, internal secret, service startup, tunnel doctor, connector setup and diagnostics. Target: P1 / Ops / High / M5 / L.

issues.title: Document operator and disaster-recovery runbooks
issues.body: M5 Task 10 sub-issue. Parent: #113. Depends on: #124–#128. Document Tailscale as administration network only (never ChatGPT MCP transport) plus recovery for agent/tunnel failures, SQLite integrity, stale lock, NEEDS_RECOVERY, credential rotation, broken upgrade and disk/worktree pressure. Target: P1 / Ops / High / M5 / M.

issues.title: Full v1.0 security and production acceptance
issues.body: M5 Task 11 final release gate. Parent: #113. Depends on: #114–#129. Run frozen install, lint, typecheck, test, build, e2e, concurrency, security, shellcheck; record every SEC-* invariant, one real E2E task, restart recovery and backup/restore validation, and final diagnostics. Any unresolved High/Critical invariant blocks v1.0.0. Target: P0 / Security / Critical / M5 / XL.
